Regular City Council Meeting
CONSOLIDATED AGENDA
December 11, 2012
05:30 P.M.
CALL TO ORDER - City Council Chambers, 200 Civic Center Drive, Vista, California
ROLL CALL
PLEDGE OF ALLEGIANCE AND INVOCATION - Reverend Beth Johnson of the Palomar Unitarian Universalist Fellowship
BROWN ACT NOTICE OF SIMULTANEOUS MEETING COMPENSATION
APPROVAL OF AGENDA
CLOSED SESSION

P2.
Friends of the Rancho Buena Vista Adobe Status Report
P3.
San Diego North Economic Development Council - Prosperity on Purpose (POP) Update
CONSENT CALENDAR
C1.
Check Register (CC)
C2.

Affordable Housing Projects - Financial, Legal, and Engineering Services (CC/CDC)
1.
City Council Resolution No. 2012- , approving an agreement with Keyser Marston Associates;
2.
City Council Resolution No. 2012- , amending the Operating Program Budget for FY 2012/13;
3.
Community Development Commission Resolution No. 2012- , amending the Operating Program Budget for FY 2012/13;
4.
City Council Resolution No. 2012- , approving an Amended Cooperative Agreement with the Community Development Commission of the City of Vista in connection with housing functions; and
5.
Community Development Commission Resolution No. 2012- , approving an Amended Cooperative Agreement with the City of Vista in connection with housing functions.

Commercial Vehicle Parking Prohibition on Various Streets (CC)
DISCUSSION
D1.
Amending the Title of Mayor Pro Tempore and Appointing a Deputy Mayor (CC)
1.
Introduce and adopt City Council Ordinance No. 2012- , amending the title of Mayor Pro Tempore to Deputy Mayor; and
2.
Appoint a Deputy Mayor for a one-year term.
D2.
Appointments of Officials to Boards, Committees, and Commissions (CC/BSD)
1.
Approve the appointment of Vista representatives to the various outside boards and commissions, and adopt the following:
a.
City Council Resolution No. 2012- , appointing Councilmember Aguilera representative and Councilmember Campbell alternate to the Board of Directors of the North San Diego County Transit District Board (NCTD);
b.
City Council Resolution No. 2012- , approving the Mayor's appointment of Mayor Ritter representative and Councilmembers Cowles and Aguilera first and second alternate representatives, respectively, to the Board of Directors of the San Diego Association of Governments (SANDAG);
c.
City Council Resolution No. 2012- , reappointing Mayor Ritter and appointing Councilmember Cowles representatives, and reappointing Councilmember Aguilera and Sewer Program Director Putnam alternate representatives to the Board of Directors of the Encina Wastewater Authority;
(Recommendation continued on following page)
(Recommendation continued from previous page)
d.
Buena Sanitation District Resolution No. 2012- , reappointing Chairperson Ritter and appointing Director Cowles representatives, and reappointing Director Aguilera and Sewer Program Director Putnam alternate representatives to the Board of Directors of the Encina Wastewater Authority.
2.
Confirm the Mayor's appointments to the agencies not listed above, but shown on Exhibit 5.
3.
Direct staff to post the changes on the web site on California Fair Political Practices Commission (FPPC) Form 806 in compliance with FPPC Regulation 18705.5.
ORAL COMMUNICATIONS
REMARKS
R1.
Reports from members of the governing bodies on outside committee meetings.
R2.
Reports and comments from City officials and members of the governing bodies.
ADJOURNMENT
